title: Training data provenance undocumented
description: No durable record links training rows to their source tables, so a deletion request cannot be traced to the model.
mitigations: Record dataset lineage from warehouse table to training row
Publish a data statement naming sources and consent basis
Add a deletion-request playbook that reaches trained artefacts

title: No drift monitoring in production
description: Input distribution shifts are not detected, so accuracy decay would go unnoticed until a customer complaint.
mitigations: Schedule weekly PSI checks on top input features
Alert when ROC AUC on a rolling holdout drops below 0.78
Document the retrain trigger and its owner

title: Third-party model terms unclear
description: An upstream fine-tuned checkpoint may forbid our intended commercial use, which would block release.
mitigations: Obtain written confirmation of the upstream licence terms
Keep an inventory of third-party components and their licences

title: No rollback path once ranked lists are sent downstream
description: A bad model release would keep ranking accounts until the batch job is manually stopped.
mitigations: Pin the previous model artifact and keep it loadable
Add a one-command kill switch for the ranking batch job

title: Evaluation set overlaps the training window
description: The holdout shares calendar months with training data, inflating the reported ROC AUC.
mitigations: Rebuild the holdout as a strictly temporal split
Publish both random and temporal metrics side by side

title: Minor dashboard tooltip truncates
description: A tooltip clips on viewports narrower than 360px; cosmetic only.
